criteria.alg_agility: Every signed record names its algorithm, so a verifier need not assume one
criteria.hybrid_ready: The format can carry two signatures over one payload (classical + PQC)
criteria.timestamped: An RFC 3161 trusted timestamp proves existence before any future break
criteria.ts_renewal: RFC 4998 evidence-record renewal, so the proof outlives its own algorithm
criteria.pqc_option: A PQC algorithm is present or selectable (ML-DSA, COSE −48/−49/−50)

alg_agility.detail: COSE header carries an alg identifier

hybrid_ready.detail: C2PA ≤v2.4 defines ONE claim signature per claim — no hybrid slot exists in the spec, independent of our usage

timestamped.detail: RFC 3161 timestamping is supported by C2PA; our selftest falls back to untimestamped when no TSA is reachable

ts_renewal.detail: no RFC 4998 evidence-record renewal in C2PA ≤v2.4

pqc_option.detail: C2PA ≤v2.4 permits ES256/EdDSA/PS256 only — all classical. RFC 9964 registered ML-DSA COSE −48/−49/−50 in May 2026 but C2PA has not adopted them
